Three delegated zones; independent environment names
Isolated trust roles • qualify producer before use
Generation + digest pinned; same bytes promoted
Public HTTPS front door; private backend VMs
Global VPC | private regional app/worker subnets
Distributed egress across zones; IP/port sizing gate
App MIG and worker MIG each select both zones
IAP TCP + OS Login; no VM public addresses
Google APIs via Private Google Access
Regional services logical; Cloud Run broker placement gated
